field.label: Enable pf sync
field.help: Sync resolved proxy-domain addresses into a pf table via pf-aliasd.

field.label: pf table
field.help: Target pf table name (usually an OPNsense External alias), e.g. GFW_Proxy.

field.label: Min TTL
field.help: Minimum seconds a resolved address stays in the table.

field.label: Max TTL
field.help: Maximum seconds a resolved address stays in the table.

field.label: Socket timeout
field.help: Timeout for talking to the pf-aliasd socket, e.g. 100ms.

field.label: Synchronous write
field.help: Wait for the daemon ACK before answering the DNS query (kills first-packet race).
